title: VTT-84600-1A
text:
VTT-84600-1A  Council District: 13 – Soto-Martinez
  CEQA: ENV-2025-5791-SE  Last Day to Act: 11-23-26
  Related Case: CPC-2025-5792-DB-PR
  Plan Area: Hollywood

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  1350 – 1362 North Western Avenue; 1377 North Serrano Avenue;
  5433 – 5499 West Fernwood Avenue

  The Department of City Planning is requesting that the matter be continued to a date certain of January
  14, 2027.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Merger and re-subdivision of the project site into three airspace lots and three ground lots; and the merger of
  10-foot and 12-foot-wide dedications along Western Avenue and a two-foot-wide dedication along Fernwood
  Avenue into the Project Site.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the August 27, 2026, Deputy Advisory Agency determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is statutorily exempt from
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to California Public Resource Code Section
  21080.66 (Assembly Bill 130);
  2. Approved, pursuant to Sections 17.03, 17.15 and 13B.7 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Vesting
  Tentative Tract Map No. 84600, for the merger and re-subdivision of the Project site into three airspace
  lots and three ground lots; and the merger of 10-foot and 12-foot-wide dedications along Western Avenue
  and a two-foot-wide dedication along Fernwood Avenue into the Project site, as shown on the map stamp-
  dated January 12, 2026; and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Georgetown 1350 Western, LLC
  Representative: Kyndra Casper, DLA Piper, LLP

  Appellant:  Doug Haines, La Mirada Avenue Neighborhood Association

  Staff:  Michelle Carter, City Planner
  michelle.carter@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1262
summary: Appeal of the approval of a subdivision map that would recombine three Hollywood sites on Western, Serrano and Fernwood avenues into three airspace lots and three ground lots. The Planning Department has asked to postpone the hearing to January 14, 2027.
